content:
This is how João Moutinho, Business & Internationalization Director at BUILT CoLAB, is quoted in the title of the latest issue of the magazine "Logística e Transportes Hoje", on the subject of digitalisation and the technological transformation of the logistics sector.


With his expertise in the areas of Smart Cities, Digitalisation and Smart Mobility, João Moutinho tells the magazine that «he believes the pandemic has raised the need to make logistics processes more expedient and more efficient, and also says it allowed many people to discover that “last-mile deliveries can be a day-to-day reality as a practical way for people to stock up or do their shopping”». For him, therefore, «the race [towards digitalisation and robotisation] has started, and whoever takes off first will (probably) gain an advantage over the competition».


You can read the full article here.


This collaboration follows another appearance by João Moutinho at the conference organised by that publication, where he was a Key Note Speaker on the topic of Smart Roads as a Necessity in the "Last Mile", where he had the opportunity to present his point of view on digitalisation.


You can also read the article "Mobility: the real problem of the last mile" here.
